title: Small dataset, TRIAD against the non-agentic baselines
hypothesis: P finishes end to end with no manual step except approval; agent overhead dominates P's time at this size.
conclusion: Wall-clock: P 2296.01s, B3 128.5s, B2 17.9s, B1 not measured. P's time beyond B3's - the agentic loop's cost, with no LLM time in it - is 0.944 of P's wall clock, so overhead dominates P's time at this size: True. P is slower than B2: True, which is the expected observation at this size and the argument for local-mode routing (LR-07). P's candidate was escalated by the acceptance policy (calibration rules still failing after calibration:sigmoid, calibration:sigmoid + class weighting removed: MISCALIBRATED) on a validation split of 243 rows - a decision left to a person, which is the platform working as designed, and at this size inside the calibration estimator's measured noise floor (experiments/calibration_noise_floor.py). P required 0 approval(s) and 0 other manual steps, so the first half of the hypothesis holds. Whole-pipeline test PR-AUC: P 0.7405 (full feature catalogue), B3 0.7871 and B2 0.79 (twelve features each) - not comparable as model quality, because the feature sets differ. Hand-written pipeline lines: B2 188, B3 291. P made 0 LLM calls, ran 4 sandboxed Spark jobs and wrote 19 audit entries and 9 decision records - the governance and evidence the baselines produce none of, which is the cost the wall-clock difference is buying. See the like-for-like trial for the only PR-AUC comparison in which the features are held constant.
limitations: B1 is not measured: it is defined as a person following a runbook, and its metrics are engineer hours. Inventing them would fabricate the comparison.

The dataset is TRIAD's synthetic generator, not Online Retail II, which has no customer, session, ticket or return tables and so cannot support the churn definition or most of the feature catalogue (ADR-0002).

P made 0 LLM calls because no provider is configured (ADR-0003). The hypothesis that 'agent overhead dominates P's time' therefore cannot be tested for LLM time. The overhead that is present - validation gates including an sbt compile, sandbox container start-up per Spark job, governance and audit writes - is measured and reported instead, and is not a substitute for the untested claim.
